description:
Queue an Optuna search for Q, R, Rd, and Qf. Then poll ``get_autotune_job``.

The tuner needs discrete or continuous linear matrices A and B, one of
double_integrator, thermal_rc_zone, soil_moisture_cascade, cart_pendulum,
unicycle_kinematics, gravity_tank, icr_skid_steer, and ackermann, or a kind
expression plant with one allowlisted scalar expression per state row.
Expressions outside that allowlist are rejected. Optional h rows and fixed
obstacle slots, path-frame residuals, and zone bands are accepted.

Call this when the weights are unknown and you can afford a closed-loop
study with plant mismatch. Optuna tunes Q, R, Rd, and Qf on the single
scenario in the request and reports overshoot and settling time. There is
no scenario bank and no never-worse check: the result is the best trial of
that study, not a comparison with weights you already have. It is an alternative to manual PID or
hand-tuned MPC. The reply is a ``job_id``. When payment
enforcement is on it also includes a ``job_token`` for ``get_autotune_job``.
It does not contain the weights. Poll until ``status`` is ``complete`` or
``failed``. The finished result's ``Q``, ``R``, ``Rd``, and ``Qf`` are the
physical weights. ``normalized_Q`` and its siblings are the unitless search box.

Payment settles when the job is accepted onto the queue, not when the study
finishes. This is POST /v1/autotune at $1.50. Send header X-API-Key when a
$29 pack still has an autotune credit. With no key, or when those credits
are gone, the call is HTTP 402 and an agent pays with x402. A full queue is HTTP 429 and is not charged. The template study uses sampler seed 7. The study itself stops
at ``timeout_seconds``. A process restart marks leftover ``running`` rows
``failed`` with ``interrupted_by_restart`` instead of deleting a paid job.

request.description: Paid Optuna study at $1.50. Send X-API-Key while the pack has an autotune credit, or pay HTTP 402 with x402 on Base USDC. Validate the plant free first, then solve, then this job when Q, R, Rd, and Qf are unknown. Each call starts a new job. Poll get_autotune_job with the returned job_id.

anyOf.description:
Allowlisted rows ``h(x, u, p) <= 0`` and fixed obstacle slots.

Soft rows use one slack per node. ``hard`` true removes those slacks.
A linear plant with any row here uses the nonlinear solver. The linear-only solver option is rejected.

h.description: Scalar rows, each h(x, u, p) <= 0. At most 8. Symbols are x[i], u[i], p[i], and pi. Same length, depth, and node caps as expression dynamics.

hard.description: True enforces the rows with no slack. Default false.

anyOf.description: At most eight circles. Their four numbers each sit outside ``np <= 8``.

position.description: Two distinct state indexes for the circle plane. Example: [0, 1].

slots.description: Circle slots. Length 1 to 8. Each is cx, cy, r, active.

items.description: One fixed circle. ``active`` is 0 or 1 and is not part of caller ``p``.

active.description: 1 keeps the circle. 0 drops the row. No other value is accepted.

cx.description: Center along the first position index, in the plant's state units.

cy.description: Center along the second position index, in the plant's state units.

obstacles.description: Fixed circles. Omit for none. The row is active * (r^2 - squared distance) <= 0.

p.description: Caller parameters for h, length 0 to 8. On an expression plant, omit this to use the plant p. Obstacle slots do not use this vector and do not count toward the cap.

slack_l1.description: L1 weight on each inequality slack. Omit for 1000. Ignored when hard is true.

slack_l2.description: L2 weight on each inequality slack. Omit for 100. Ignored when hard is true.

constraints.description: Same h rows and obstacle slots as solve. Omit for an unconstrained study.

anyOf.description:
Path-frame and zone residuals. Economic prices stay the linear stage vectors.

``linear_state_cost`` and ``linear_input_cost`` are the economic term. They are
linear in the node. Path samples, zone centers, half-widths, and weights are
parameters of the compiled problem.

path.description: One path sample per state node, length N+1. Each sample is along, across, and heading, in the position indexes' units and the heading state's units.

anyOf.description: Squared path residuals. Heading uses both sin and 1 - cos.

heading.description: State index of the heading. Must differ from both position indexes.

heading_weight.description: Weight on both squared heading residuals, sin(heading error) and 1 - cos(heading error). Must be >= 0. Default 1. The two residuals share this weight.

lateral_weight.description: Weight on the squared cross-track residual. Must be >= 0. Default 1.

longitudinal_weight.description: Weight on the squared along-track residual. Must be >= 0. Default 1.

position.description: Two distinct state indexes of the plane the path is written in. Example: [0, 1].

path_frame.description: Along-track, cross-track, and heading residuals. Omit for none.

zones.description: Slack bands, at most 8. Each band is two inequalities and one slack.

items.description: One slack band. Inside the band the residual is zero.

center.description: Band center, in that state's units.

half_width.description: Half width of the band. Must be >= 0.

state.description: State index this band applies to.

weight.description: Quadratic weight on the band slack. Zero leaves the band unpaid. Must be >= 0.

costs.description: Same path-frame and zone residuals as solve. Omit to tune the quadratic cost only.

anyOf.description: Declarative stages. JSON only: there is no code to run.

held_out.description: Required scenarios scored after the last stage. They are not used to train or to apply the cap.

items.description: Step-reference rollout used by the auto-tuner.

disturbance_onset_step.description: Closed-loop step index when step_disturbance turns on. Default 0, must be >= 0.

n_steps.description: Closed-loop steps in the scored rollout. Default 40, must be >= 1 and <= 200.

plant_model_mismatch_pct.description: Plant-model mismatch in percent. The plant is scaled by 1 + pct/100. Default 0.

seed.description: Seed for the sensor noise. Default 0.

sensor_noise_std.description: Sensor noise standard deviation, in the plant's state units. Default 0, must be >= 0.

step_disturbance.description: Constant disturbance applied from disturbance_onset_step, length nd. Omit for none.

step_reference.description: Step state reference held for the rollout, length nx.

x0.description: Initial state for the rollout, length nx, in the plant's state units.

stages.description: Ordered stages. Length 1 to 4. Each stage warm-starts from the previous stage's best feasible trial.

items.description: One fixed bank. The numbers are the only plant the stage trains on.

scenarios.description: Training scenarios for this stage. Length 1 to 12. The stage does not add scenarios of its own.

items.description: Step-reference rollout used by the auto-tuner.

disturbance_onset_step.description: Closed-loop step index when step_disturbance turns on. Default 0, must be >= 0.

n_steps.description: Closed-loop steps in the scored rollout. Default 40, must be >= 1 and <= 200.

plant_model_mismatch_pct.description: Plant-model mismatch in percent. The plant is scaled by 1 + pct/100. Default 0.

seed.description: Seed for the sensor noise. Default 0.

sensor_noise_std.description: Sensor noise standard deviation, in the plant's state units. Default 0, must be >= 0.

step_disturbance.description: Constant disturbance applied from disturbance_onset_step, length nd. Omit for none.

step_reference.description: Step state reference held for the rollout, length nx.

x0.description: Initial state for the rollout, length nx, in the plant's state units.

trials.description: Optuna trials for this stage. Must be >= 1 and <= 40.

validation.description: Cap scenarios for this stage. Length 1 to 12. Used by the regression cap, not as the held-out block.

items.description: Step-reference rollout used by the auto-tuner.

disturbance_onset_step.description: Closed-loop step index when step_disturbance turns on. Default 0, must be >= 0.

n_steps.description: Closed-loop steps in the scored rollout. Default 40, must be >= 1 and <= 200.

plant_model_mismatch_pct.description: Plant-model mismatch in percent. The plant is scaled by 1 + pct/100. Default 0.

seed.description: Seed for the sensor noise. Default 0.

sensor_noise_std.description: Sensor noise standard deviation, in the plant's state units. Default 0, must be >= 0.

step_disturbance.description: Constant disturbance applied from disturbance_onset_step, length nd. Omit for none.

step_reference.description: Step state reference held for the rollout, length nx.

x0.description: Initial state for the rollout, length nx, in the plant's state units.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget for every stage and the held-out scoring, in seconds. Must be > 0 and <= 120.

curriculum.description: Optional JSON stages. Omit to tune the single scenario in this request. When set, each stage uses only its supplied scenarios and the held-out block is scored afterward.

kpi.description: Scorecard weights and the Optuna trial and time budget.

control_effort_weight.description: Weight on control effort in the score. Must be >= 0.

max_optuna_trials.description: Optuna trials in the study. Must be >= 1 and <= 40.

settling_time_weight.description: Weight on settling time in the score. Must be >= 0.

slew_penalty_weight.description: Weight on input slew in the score. Must be >= 0.

target_max_overshoot_pct.description: Overshoot target in percent. Must be >= 0.

timeout_seconds.description: Study wall-clock limit in seconds. Must be > 0 and <= 120. The study stops at this budget.

scenario.description: Closed-loop rollout the tuner scores, including mismatch and noise.

disturbance_onset_step.description: Closed-loop step index when step_disturbance turns on. Default 0, must be >= 0.

n_steps.description: Closed-loop steps in the scored rollout. Default 40, must be >= 1 and <= 200.

plant_model_mismatch_pct.description: Plant-model mismatch in percent. The plant is scaled by 1 + pct/100. Default 0.

seed.description: Seed for the sensor noise. Default 0.

sensor_noise_std.description: Sensor noise standard deviation, in the plant's state units. Default 0, must be >= 0.

step_disturbance.description: Constant disturbance applied from disturbance_onset_step, length nd. Omit for none.

step_reference.description: Step state reference held for the rollout, length nx.

x0.description: Initial state for the rollout, length nx, in the plant's state units.

system.description: Plant for the study. Free validate_problem first. This request is the paid autotune step after a solve, when the quadratic weights are still unknown.

oneOf.description:
Discrete or continuous linear plant.

Continuous ``(A, B, Bd)`` are converted with a matrix exponential / zero-order
hold at ``dt``. Discrete matrices are used as given. ``Bd`` defaults to ``B``
(input disturbance) when omitted.

A.description: State matrix, shape nx by nx, with nx <= 24. Discrete map or continuous xdot, matching time_mode.

B.description: Input matrix, shape nx by nu, with nu <= 12.

Bd.description: Disturbance matrix, shape nx by nd, with nd <= 12. Omit to reuse B as an input disturbance.

C.description: Output matrix, shape ny by nx. Omit for identity, which uses the full state.

D.description: Feedthrough matrix, shape ny by nu. Omit when there is no direct term.

N.description: Prediction horizon in steps. Must be >= 1. Values above 100 are rejected.

dt.description: Sample time. Must be > 0. Continuous plants are zero-order-hold discretized at this step. Use seconds unless A is written in another time unit.

du_max.description: Upper slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

du_min.description: Lower slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

kind.description: Plant kind. Must be "linear" for matrices A and B.

time_mode.description: discrete uses A and B as given. continuous is zero-order-hold discretized at dt. Default discrete.

u_max.description: Upper input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

u_min.description: Lower input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

x_max.description: Upper state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for 1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

x_min.description: Lower state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for -1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

oneOf.description: Registered dynamics template plus a validated parameter dictionary.

N.description: Prediction horizon in steps. Must be >= 1 and <= 100.

du_max.description: Upper slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

du_min.description: Lower slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

kind.description: Plant kind. Must be "nonlinear" for a registered template.

name.description: Registered template: double_integrator, thermal_rc_zone, soil_moisture_cascade, unicycle_kinematics, gravity_tank, cart_pendulum, icr_skid_steer, or ackermann.

parameters.description: Template knobs, one number per required key. double_integrator and unicycle_kinematics: dt > 0 (seconds). thermal_rc_zone: dt > 0, capacity > 0, time_constant > 0, and ambient. soil_moisture_cascade: dt > 0, capacity > 0, tau_1 > 0, tau_2 > 0, tau_3 > 0, k_12 >= 0, k_23 >= 0. gravity_tank: dt > 0, discharge > 0, inflow_gain > 0. cart_pendulum: dt, cart_mass, pole_mass, friction, inertia, gravity, and length, each > 0. icr_skid_steer: dt > 0 and slip, a signed length with abs(slip) <= 10. Body-frame lateral velocity equals slip * yaw_rate. If x_icr is the forward coordinate of the instantaneous center, positive ahead of the reference point, slip = -x_icr. ackermann: dt > 0 and wheelbase > 0. The steer component of u_min and u_max must lie inside ±1.2 rad. Unknown keys are rejected.

u_max.description: Upper input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

u_min.description: Lower input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

x_max.description: Upper state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for 1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

x_min.description: Lower state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for -1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

oneOf.description:
Allowlisted scalar expressions, one per state row.

``time_mode`` ``continuous`` is integrated with classical RK4 at ``dt``.
``discrete`` means each expression is already the next state. ``p`` is a
numeric parameter vector baked into the discrete map. ``nd`` may be 0.
Declaring ``nd >= 1`` and never using ``d[i]`` is accepted; detectability
is then false because the disturbance columns of the discrete Jacobian are zero.

C.description: Output matrix, shape ny by nx, with ny <= 8. Omit for identity.

N.description: Prediction horizon in steps. Must be >= 1 and <= 60.

dt.description: Sample time. Must be > 0. Continuous plants are zero-order-hold discretized at this step. Use seconds unless A is written in another time unit.

du_max.description: Upper slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

du_min.description: Lower slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

f.description: One scalar expression per state, length nx. Each string is at most 512 characters and the set is at most 4096. Symbols are x[i], u[i], d[i], p[i], pi, and the smooth allowlist sin, cos, tan, atan, atan2, exp, log, tanh, sqrt, hypot, sq, plus + - * / and ^2 ^3 ^4.

kind.description: Plant kind. Must be "expression" for allowlisted scalar expressions.

nd.description: Disturbance dimension. Must be >= 0 and <= 4. Zero is a plant with no disturbance channel. An unused d[i] when nd is positive does not change the map and reports detectable false.

p.description: Numeric parameter values, length np. Baked into the discrete map.

time_mode.description: continuous integrates the expressions with classical RK4 at dt. discrete uses each expression as the next state. Default continuous.

u_max.description: Upper input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

u_min.description: Lower input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

x_max.description: Upper state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for 1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

x_min.description: Lower state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for -1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.
